title: Jesus... I Read The Chapter And Forget It By Noon 📖
topic: she reads her Bible every morning and forgets it by lunch, and feels like a bad Christian

bible.text: Thy word have I hid in mine heart, that I might not sin against thee.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... I read the chapter. By noon it's gone. 📖

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Every morning, highlighter, journal, the whole routine. And somehow it all evaporates before lunch.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You remember what you need exactly when it's needed. The remembering was never your job to begin with.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: But what if that means I'm not taking it seriously? Everyone else quotes chapters at me like trophies.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You showed up every morning. That is what serious looks like. Seed grows under soil you never watch.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Read again tomorrow, slower if you like. I'll handle the remembering. I've never lost a verse of you.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: Send this to someone who feels behind in their Bible. 📖
